A phrase of the lesson as it's said at normal speed, cut from the lesson's MP3, for a
card's Audio field.

The language's level from its last snapshot of the deck: known words by frequency band
(`bands`, each `start` to `end` places in the list), how many of the `top` most common are
known, the share of everyday speech they make up (`speech`, 0 to 1, null without
frequencies), and `history`, one figure a study day, oldest first, today's included. 404 for
a language with no frequency list (Toki Pona), 409 before its deck has been read.

post.description:
The next question of a talk in English about a lesson's topic, written by Claude. Reads
nothing of the deck, writes no card and grades nothing.

What the learner would want to say, from what they said in English: a line in the
language for each, built from their words, with the words they lack marked.

Themes for a lesson, written by Claude from the learner's words. Reads the snapshot of
the deck for the common words it lacks; adds no note, writes no card and grades nothing.

Words Claude suggests for a cram's topic, for the learner to pick from. Writes nothing:
the app tags the ones the deck has and queues the rest, each behind the learner's tap.

Phrases Claude writes for a cram's topic from its words, for the learner to pick from.
Writes nothing: the app keeps the checked ones on the cram, and none is a note.
